inputs: permissions, cost, latency, and failure evidence
invariants: Profiles are task-class and version specific.
Self-description and marketing claims are not benchmark evidence.
Permissions and safety are hard gates.
procedure: Define task demand and measurable profile dimensions.
Filter by permissions and hard safety constraints.
Score fit with confidence and version-specific failure evidence.
Penalize correlated blind spots and coordination overhead.
Assign primary, verifier, fallback, authority envelope, and recertification triggers.

confidence: may adjust only through declared evidence and method
knowledge: may add or revise typed records only with provenance
memory: no persistent memory write unless explicitly contracted and scope-bound
registry: may propose changes; canonical mutation requires admission and evidence
runtime: bounded by target orchestration, permissions, containment, and rollback

summary: Compose bounded teams with complementary strengths, explicit roles, information boundaries, independent verification, fallback, and stop conditions.
title: Multi-Agent Composition Planner
when_to_use: Use when planning, execution, critique, and verification require different profiles.
